The '''E-9 blaster''' was a small [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced as early as [[3653 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Great Galactic War]]. The pistol was used in that [[Time/Legends|time]] period by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]], who worked for the criminal organization the [[Exchange]].<ref name="Deceived" /> The E-9 was still in use during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nearly four millennia later.<ref name="JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>
